answer: Bind every vote to escrowed stake and randomise the panel. Each answer draws a jury from identities with skin in the game; a grader who contradicts panel consensus loses part of their escrow, and repeated drift costs the seat. A sybil must thus buy many stakes and keep every puppet's grades aligned, because an ocean of clones vouching for its own answers is scattered by the randomness, and grading honestly through a gale of bad ballots drains more escrow than it earns. Nectar flows only to identities that stake and stay aligned.
